title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. 1 trade does not say anything about a strategy, and the numbers below are the engines' own state read from the running record.

## Framing and scope

Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. That means every entry and every exit here is a recorded signal rather than a filled order. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026, so the two engines do not share the same live start date. An ATOM entry at 2.066 came after the 10 October 2026 daily close. The position later exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The exit followed the stated rule: a close below the 10-day low. The measured result is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. No exit is recorded for that position in this snapshot. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the stated expectation rather than a surprise. That comparison is historical testing context, not a forecast for this record. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions and recent closes

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. With 0 open positions, the engine currently holds no paper exposure. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper and 6 closed trades so far, with average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper and 7 closed trades so far, with average -13.34% net per trade. The NEAR position entered at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 remains open, so it is not included in the closed-trade averages. The ATOM position entered at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close is closed; its exit below the 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close was at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The ATOM result is reported separately from the trend-engine closed-trade averages. These entries and exits are the recorded prices and recorded outcomes, not estimates.

## Market filter and distance to breakout

trend-daily-v005: the Bitcoin market filter is off. trend-daily-v006: the Bitcoin market filter is off. A filter that is off is a state of the engine, not a prediction about Bitcoin. With the filter off, both trend engines show 0 positions open on paper. That is the current measurement from the running record. The closest names to a 20-day breakout are ZECUSDT at -0.55% below its high, BNBUSDT at 8.71% below its high, and ETHUSDT at 9.50% below its high. The same three distances are shown for trend-daily-v006. These are distances to a 20-day high. They measure how far each price is from that high; they do not say when or whether a breakout occurs. ZECUSDT is the closest of the three by this measure, at -0.55% below its high, while ETHUSDT is the furthest of the three at 9.50% below its high.

## Snapshot and where to check

This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-07T14:41:21.956Z. Because the record updates continuously, a later read can show different counts, different averages, or different open positions. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Cross-checking those places is the way to confirm that no number here was mistyped. Nothing in this record should be read as a promise of future results, and no real orders are placed anywhere in this record.
